resources.string: Translate Discord messages and switch between original and translated text.

LSPosed disconnected. Settings cannot be saved.
Invalid settings. Review the values and try again.
Saved settings are invalid. They have not been loaded or changed. Editing, saving, checks, requests, and sync are blocked. Reset saved settings explicitly to configure again.

This permanently deletes ALL stored configuration: API URL, API key, model, target language, headers, system prompt, provider protocol, streaming, timeout, concurrency, and the auto-translation switch. Deletions sync to LSPosed when available. Defaults become active after reset; nothing is deleted unless you confirm. Continue?
Reset could not be persisted. Configuration remains locked. %1$s
All stored settings were reset and synced to LSPosed. Defaults are now active. Restart Discord to apply.
All stored settings were reset on this device. Defaults are now active locally. LSPosed was unavailable; remote deletion will retry when it reconnects.
All stored settings were reset on this device, but deletion could not sync to LSPosed. Remote settings may still be active. Sync will retry when LSPosed reconnects.
LSPosed is unavailable. Enable the module and its scope.
LSPosed disconnected. Settings cannot be saved.
Saved. Restart Discord to apply the changes.
